title: Create maintenance matrix with single dependency
gherkin:
Feature: Maintenance Matrix Dependency
  Scenario: Create maintenance matrix with single dependency
    Given a maintenance matrix system is initialized
    When I create a maintenance item A
    And I create a maintenance item B
    And I define B as dependent on A
    Then the maintenance matrix should record B depends on A
    And the dependency relationship should be retrievable
rationale: Validates that the system can establish and record a basic dependency relationship between two maintenance items in the matrix.
generationSummary: Test cases for maintenance matrix dependency requirement. The requirement specifies that a maintenance matrix should handle dependencies between maintenance items. Test cases cover creation, validation, dependency tracking, conflict detection, and resolution of maintenance matrix dependencies.

title: Create maintenance matrix with multiple dependencies
gherkin:
Feature: Maintenance Matrix Dependency
  Scenario: Create maintenance matrix with multiple dependencies
    Given a maintenance matrix system is initialized
    When I create maintenance items A, B, C, and D
    And I define B as dependent on A
    And I define C as dependent on A
    And I define D as dependent on B and C
    Then the maintenance matrix should record all dependency relationships
    And item D should have two dependencies
    And item A should have two dependents
rationale: Ensures the system can handle complex dependency chains where a single item can have multiple dependencies and multiple dependents.
